description: Source code for Android Maven Resources Compiler implementing SourceGeneratingCompiler, handling resource generation via Maven, managing generation items, validity states, and integration with IntelliJ IDEA APIs.

classes.name: AndroidMavenResourcesCompiler
classes.description: Implements resource compilation for Android projects using Maven, manages generation items, validity states, and integrates with IntelliJ build system.

classes.name: MyGenerationItem
classes.description: Represents a generated resource Java file, tracks module, package, source root, and validity state.

classes.name: MyValidityState
classes.description: Tracks validity of resource names and Maven artifact timestamps to determine if regeneration is needed.

classes.name: PrepareAction
classes.description: Prepares generation items for modules that require resource processing based on Maven and Android facet configurations.

methods.name: getPresentableFile
methods.description: Returns null; not used for presentation.

methods.name: getGenerationItems
methods.description: Creates generation items by analyzing project modules and Maven configuration.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Performs resource generation, refreshes generated files, and marks them dirty for rebuild.

methods.name: doGenerate
methods.description: Internal method that executes resource generation, filters affected modules, and handles message reporting.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns description string for the compiler.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates compiler configuration, always returns true.

methods.name: createValidityState
methods.description: Creates a new validity state object from input data.
